usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.beta.threads.create(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "string", "attachments": [{"file_id": "string", "tools": [{"type": None}]}], "metadata": {"key": "string"}}], tool_resources={"code_interpreter": {"file_ids": ["string"]}, "file_search": None}, metadata={"key": "string"})
print(result)

fields.name: messages
fields.description: A list of [messages](/docs/api-reference/messages) to start the thread with.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `thread`.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the thread was created.
